outputs.explanation: Panel A is a bar chart (mean ± SD) of Tmprss11b normalized counts across mouse models, and individual biological replicate data points (colored dots for SCLC, LUSC, LUAD) are overlaid on each bar, satisfying the requirement to show underlying data alongside the average.
Panel B is a schematic diagram illustrating the Ad-Cre administration and experimental workflow, not a data plot, so the individual-data-points check does not apply.
Panel C shows representative MRI images of mice, which is an imaging panel rather than a quantitative plot, so the check does not apply.
Panel D consists of representative H&E micrographs, not a plot of averaged data, so the check is not applicable.
Panel E shows representative H&E and RNAscope fluorescence micrographs, not a quantitative plot, so the check does not apply.
Panel F shows representative H&E and RNAscope micrographs comparing squamous tumor and normal lung, not a plot of averaged data, so the check does not apply.
Panel G shows representative H&E and RNAscope micrographs with annotations, not a quantitative plot, so the check does not apply.
